thread:
maya: Quick experiment notes — changed autoscaler for spot-backed inference pools.
sam: summary pls
maya: TL;DR: lowered scale_out_threshold from queue_len>=30 -> >=20, introduced surge_multiplier=1.5 for 90s, cooldown 300s. Mixed-capacity pools handled more load without immediate on-demand fallbacks, but p99 spiked during 2 eviction waves.
jin: numbers? and how are we detecting eviction waves?
maya: short numbers from the 4h canary
• spot GPU spend -12% vs baseline
• on-demand fallback events -42% (counts)
• average GPU_util unchanged ~72%
• p99 latency baseline 160ms -> 320ms during eviction windows (2x)
• queue_len tail still had spikes to 70+ when reclaimers hit a zone
lina: interesting — did you see region skew? which AZs triggered fallback?
maya: yes, us-west-2a had concentrated reclaims. autoscaler picked up capacity in other AZs but cross-AZ routing hit network cold-starts for KV cache so latency went up.
jin: we should make the autoscaler eviction-aware. propose adding a "spot_reclaim_rate" metric (events/min per AZ) and a circuit-breaker: if reclaim_rate > 3/min for >60s then reduce surge_multiplier to 0 and proactively spin up on-demand in a different AZ.
sam: +1. Also consider a sliding window for cooldowns — the fixed 300s hurts when we get intermittent waves.
maya: thinking of an adaptive cooldown: cooldown_ms = base * (1 + reclaim_rate_window / 5). so if reclaim rate is high cooldown grows.
jin: also add a short-term admission control: if p99 > 250ms and queue_len > 40 then reject new lower-priority requests (hipri flag) and return 429+Retry-After instead of forcing fallback.
lina: we need observability tags for experiments. please add rollout_id and experiment_arm to traces and cost dashboards. and create an alert: "autoscaler: p99 > 250ms AND on_demand_fallbacks > 0 => rollback candidate".
ops-bot: deploy-bot started canary rollout of autoscaler-config v2 to 10% of spot fleet (tag: preempt-fleet-2026-03)
maya: will run A/B for 24h. plan: arm A = surge_multiplier 1.5 cooldown 300s, arm B = surge_multiplier 1.0 adaptive cooldown. will capture cost, p99, fallback_count, reclaim_rate.
sam: don't forget to log the exact config in config-store and annotate the commit: git sha abcdef1
maya: pasted the config snippet we used:
```
autoscaler:
  scale_out_threshold: 20
  surge:
    multiplier: 1.5
    duration_s: 90
  cooldown_s: 300
  fallback_policy:
    on_demand_threshold: 3  # concurrent fallbacks per AZ
    cross_az_fallback: true
```
jin: for the circuit-breaker pseudocode
```
if reclaim_rate(az, 60s) > 3:
  set_surges(multiplier=0)
  provision(on_demand, target=pool_target * 0.25, az!=affected_az)
```

jin: will add reclaim_rate metric and a small agent to the spot watcher to emit it.
lina: i'll add the dashboard panels and the rollback alert. also adding an SLO doc for hipri behavior during spot storms.
ops-bot: canary metrics will be posted to #infra-metrics every 10m (tag: preempt-fleet-2026-03)
maya: thanks — will share the final A/B results. if anyone wants to join the 2pm sync to review, ping me.
sam: pinged. :thumbsup:
